turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Why was the zero entered at all?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
Turn the screen so I can see it. People write in another document and paste it in. And your own procedure says someone calls me before a mark goes in, which nobody did.
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
That tells me when text arrived, not who wrote it. Did you speak to Owen about it before the zero, yes or no?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not a witness here, Hale. You didn't answer my question: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and a written answer on whether anyone spoke to him before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a trip to the principal; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got there, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before you called her in one plain sentence and moved on, which earned a flat okay, because it answered her complaint about process without excuses.
What cost ground: You described the edit times but never offered her the screen, and you did not answer her point that he could have pasted it in from elsewhere, so nothing she could check ever reached her.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night times and your question about what he was doing at midnight landed very close to that night, but that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she raised pasting from another document, answer it right then with something she can check, such as the full history on the screen, before asking about midnight.
